tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists the Supabase projects connected to this account with id, name, connection state and whether each is ready to run. Call this first to get a project_id.

tools.name: run_review
tools.description: Starts an authorization test run on a connected project and returns the run_id and status. If the project already has a run waiting to start, returns that run instead of starting another. Runs that do not fail count against the monthly allowance.

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Returns a run's status (queued, running, complete or failed), its current stage, timestamps and, when a signed report exists, its verify_url.

tools.name: wait_for_run
tools.description: Waits up to timeout_seconds (1 to 60) for a run to finish, then returns the same information as get_run_status. Call it again while the status is still queued or running.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Returns the cells that did not pass in a complete run that has a signed report — verdict, surface, operation, boundary, identity, layer outcomes and notes — plus tenancy flags, blocking findings and, when the report includes catalog hygiene checks, the hygiene block (the checks run, each finding's c

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Returns the full signed report of a complete run as the exact stored JSON, with its verify_url and report_sha256 (sha256 of the canonical signed bytes, the fingerprint shown on the verify page). Use get_findings for the compact view.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "run_review" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
